about: Recorded runs of test/test_pacer.js, the pacer timing test in this repository. Each run watches 3 full rounds of the breathing pattern, 9 phase changes in all, and records how far each observed change landed from its ideal time, in milliseconds. These are builder test runs on the build machine. The Still page itself collects nothing and makes no network calls.
method: node test/test_pacer.js: 3 full rounds, 9 phase transitions, drift measured against the ideal phase times computed from total elapsed time.
unit: milliseconds of drift, largest in the run (max) and average in the run (mean)
